answer.report_md:
### 画出来要什么
页面含一张分组数据表，以及一张29国单面板范围图；后者须绘制圆点、短横、垂直连接线、灰色底板、双向网格、旋转国名、图上方图例及红色EU27重点值。

### 定位一个值难在哪
例如38须同时绑定“Germany”和“65 years or over”。它没有数值标签，只能依据0–80轴及10点间隔估读，还要区别圆点与短横系列。

### 不确定的
20和38在图中可能各有多个近似或相同值；按阅读顺序分别归于France老年圆点和Germany老年圆点。连接线计入marks。

“StatLink https://stat.link/79bcw8” is printed below the figure.
“% of people reporting to spend 150 minutes or more per week of physical activity” fixes the scale.

Country labels from “Norway” to “Romania” are diagonally rotated.
The plotting area has a light grey fill.
The EU27 older-age point is red while other older-age points are blue.

answer.hardest_step_why: 38需绑定Germany和65 years or over；29个旋转国名使标签关联最难。境。接线计入marks。

examples.quote: Figure 2.17. Only 22% of people aged over 65 meet the WHO recommendation on minimum physical activity per week
examples.why: 需拆分图号、标题、单位轴题，并保留其相对位置。

examples.quote: Blue circular points and black horizontal tick markers are joined vertically for every country.
examples.why: 同面板两种标记必须记录系列与标记形状，避免把短横误作误差棒。

examples.quote: The value axis runs from 0 to 80 in ticks of 10.
examples.why: 无点值标签，精度取决于刻度间隔和标记位置。

examples.quote: Behavioural risk factors; Environmental risk factors (mortality)
examples.why: 整页导出须保留表题、分组行、注释和来源的层级。

examples.quote: The EU27 older-age point is red; the other older-age points are blue.
examples.why: 红色强调未由图例命名，但承载EU27重点值的语义。
